search_text: published ZDI-12-161 ZDI-CAN-1487 EMC AutoStart ftAgent Opcode 0x2d Subcode 0x1194 Parsing Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2012-08-22 CVE-2012-0409 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2012-0409 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['EMC'] ['AutoStart'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of the EMC Autostart ftAgent, which is deployed on machines managed by EMC Autostart by default. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the parsing routines for op-codes used by EMC Autostart ftAgent's proprietary network protocol. This ftAgent.exe service listens on TCP port 8045, and performs arithmetic for memory size calculation using values read from the network without validation. This arithmetic is susceptible to integer overflow, causing the memory allocation to be undersized, ultimately allowing for heap-based memory corruption. An attacker can exploit this condition to gain remote code execution as user SYSTEM. EMC has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
